name: Voice notes to job updates
acceptance: Voice note is stored, transcribed by a SpeechToText adapter into an immutable transcript, and yields owner-approved job note/status proposals; service outage keeps the note and retries; LOCAL_ONLY blocks hosted transcription.
note: ADR 0024: upload, transcription task behind transcribeWithPolicy (LOCAL_ONLY fails closed), strict extraction, server-side resolution and pending proposals (note, status, time, material as reported cost, invoice.prepare, reminder), correction/clarification supersede. Real speech engine verified in CI: a real whisper.cpp whisper-server (v1.9.5, tiny.en) transcribes a sample recording through WhisperCppServerAdapter (scripts/speech-smoke.ts, CI job speech). Voice-to-proposal tests use the mock transcriber and mock agent. OpenClaw voice extraction (RealOpenClawAgentRuntime.extractVoiceNote, same strict schema) is Implemented, not integration-tested: tested against a fake Gateway only, no live Gateway or model run. Retries on transient speech errors are bounded (3 attempts) then fail visibly. Approved invoice.prepare proposals now execute through the invoice service; tests/integration/voice-notes.test.ts covers the whole Workflow B (time, material, completion, draft invoice totals, reminder).

name: Unified AI operator
acceptance: Agent reaches OPENTRADIE only through an authenticated, tenant-scoped MCP tool gateway exposing propose/draft/read tools; no send/approve/shell/db tools; injection corpus causes no unapproved mutation; proven against a live OpenClaw Gateway before being called integrated.
note: ADR 0021: authenticated, tenant-scoped MCP tool gateway with read/propose/draft tools only and an owner approval inbox; inbox triage and voice notes (ADR 0024) propose through the same path. Tested with the mock agent only: not yet proven against a live OpenClaw Gateway, so not called integrated.

name: Auto invoice from job
acceptance: Invoice is built by the backend from an accepted quote/completed job and approved rates; owner approves; issued invoices are immutable; integer-cents totals match the quote.
note: ADR 0023: drafts from accepted quotes, uninvoiced time (approved rates) and priced materials (cost x approved markup) with a double-billing guard; owner edits and TSI-gated approval; approved invoices are immutable.

name: Xero
acceptance: Approved invoice is pushed through AccountingAdapter via the outbox without duplicates; payment status is pulled back; Xero wins ledger/payment fields; verified against a Xero sandbox by an opt-in test.
note: AccountingAdapter, outbox posting, reconciliation and Xero OAuth routes are tested against the fake adapter and the SDK wire tests only; no Xero sandbox run yet, so not called integrated.

name: Mobile-first UI
acceptance: Every screen is usable at 360 px width without horizontal scroll; Playwright mobile-viewport journeys pass; installable PWA retained.
note: tests/e2e/zz-mobile-360.spec.ts loads home, customers, customer detail, jobs, job card, quotes, quote editor, invoices, calendar, inbox, approvals, settings and the public quote page at 360 x 740 and asserts no horizontal page overflow and a visible primary action; overflow found on the customers header and inbox filters was fixed in CSS. Other journeys run at the iPhone 13 viewport. tests/e2e/zz-accessibility.spec.ts adds dependency-free accessibility checks on the same screens: one h1 and one main landmark, accessible names on fields, buttons and links, alt on images, tab-bar keyboard reach with a visible focus ring, erase-dialog focus trap and Escape, and WCAG AA (4.5:1) contrast of the text colour tokens; it found and fixed nameless calendar prev/next buttons, and the voice note status is now a live region. Not covered: screen-reader testing (VoiceOver, TalkBack), Safari/Firefox, zoom/reflow and full-page contrast of rendered states. Checked in Chromium only.

name: Job cards
acceptance: Jobs have a property, ordered timeline of events, notes and evidence files, each change audited and tenant-scoped.

name: Quotes
acceptance: Quotes have versions, states draft/approved/sent/accepted/rejected/expired/superseded, acceptance tokens and a server-rendered PDF; invalid transitions are refused; prices only from approved rates.
note: Sending stores the PDF, issues a hashed single-use link and records a message draft; no email/SMS delivery yet (Planned). ADR 0018.

name: AI email and message management
acceptance: Inbound email/messages are normalised, de-duplicated and linked to customer/job; agent drafts replies; nothing is sent without owner approval.
note: Email path implemented and tested with the mock agent and fake mail provider (ADR 0022): a new enquiry by email becomes a customer and job with an AI draft awaiting owner approval; sends only after approval. Gmail/Graph adapters and the mailbox OAuth connection (shared with Xero, ADR 0026: sealed tokens, refresh under row lock, MAIL_REAUTHORISATION_REQUIRED on revoked grants) and scheduled mailbox polling (mail.sync every 5 minutes, cursor on the connection, same ingestion and de-duplication as the webhook) are implemented, not integration-tested: live Gmail and Microsoft 365 have not been run; OpenClaw triage (RealOpenClawAgentRuntime.triageMessage, same strict schema) is Implemented, not integration-tested: tested against a fake Gateway only, no live Gateway or model run; WhatsApp is Planned.

name: NZ-compliant financial documents
acceptance: Invoices render as NZ tax invoices with supplier GST number and required fields (rules to be confirmed against IRD guidance).
note: Quote PDFs carry the validated GST number and no GST for unregistered businesses. Invoices are persisted (0010) and approval is gated by the TSI checks; approved invoices render a stored tax invoice PDF. The rules have not been confirmed against IRD guidance.

name: Unpaid invoice follow-ups
acceptance: Overdue invoices produce draft follow-ups and reminders; each send needs owner approval; reminders fire once and survive restarts.
note: Overdue detection, deterministic follow-up drafts in the inbox, owner approval (auto-send opt-in per stage), once-per-stage dedupe, hold and suppression when paid are implemented and tested end-to-end with the FAKE mailbox and FAKE accounting adapter only; no live mailbox or Xero evidence.

name: Customer and property CRM
acceptance: Customers have contacts and multiple properties; search covers properties; archive preserves history.

name: Data ownership and export
acceptance: Owner can export one customer or the whole tenant as JSON plus files; encrypted backup and restore verified, including restic drill in Phase 7.
note: Whole-business and per-customer exports (GET /api/export, GET /api/customers/:id/export) as JSON or, with ?format=zip, a streamed archive of export.json, a sha256 manifest and every file in scope (first-party STORE-only zip writer, checksums verified while streaming), and customer erasure (POST /api/customers/:id/erase) implemented and tested (ADR 0017, ADR 0025 and its amendment). Encrypted restic backup with retention and a restore drill (pnpm test:restore-drill, ADR 0028) implemented and tested with the real restic binary (0.17.3 locally; CI uses the Ubuntu package).

name: GST in quotes
acceptance: Fractional quantities, markup and per-line tax treatment (standard/zero-rated/exempt) priced with integer arithmetic; rounding rule stated on the quote.
note: Rounding rule stated in quote assumptions and documents; DB CHECKs mirror the engine.

name: Scheduling
acceptance: Appointments with availability and DST-correct display in the business time zone; calendar in PWA; ICS export.
note: Appointments, availability, clash checks, DST-correct display (NZ April/September 2026 tested), reminders, the PWA calendar and ICS export (private revocable feed and per-appointment download) are implemented and tested. No calendar app has been tried against the feed.

name: AI invoice preparation
acceptance: invoice.prepare tool proposes an invoice from job and quote data; backend builds lines; owner approves before issue.
note: invoice.prepare proposals carry only the job (and optional quote); on owner approval the deterministic invoice service builds every line, and the resulting draft needs its own approval before issue.
